name: fonts_cyrillic
_comment: The dialogue glyph font with Cyrillic, without a model: dialogue_latin plus U+0400-045F, Ukrainian GHE WITH UPTURN and the numero sign (Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian, Bulgarian, Serbian, Macedonian), with the coverage check against strings_cyrillic.csv (a Godot translation CSV, one pangram per language): the pack fails, naming language and string id, if a string uses a character the font lacks. Authored: written with Claude (Opus 5.5, claude-opus-5-5).
